method.primary: Per request (last-first token arrival)/127; mean over background requests, then repeat mean ± sample SD.
method.event: Offset 0 is actual first prefill chunk. Compare identical background sequence/output ordinal in same-repeat baseline. Windows 1/5/16 plus complete prefill span. Exclude unresolved bundled intervals/partial batches; union overlapping windows before averaging.
method.queue: Server arrival to first prefill schedule wall time; not end-to-end network latency.
method.limitations: Single RTX 4090 adaptation; workload changes interference count with batch. A rising gap alone does not establish a batch-dependent hardware interference mechanism. GPU samples every 0.5 s do not resolve individual steps.

run.statistic: mean all 127 token arrival gaps per background, then requests, then repeats
run.failure_policy: retain; no inference retries; stop on failed checks
run.persistence: buffer raw evidence during inference; flush after every in-flight request has ended
